The '''Hero of the Republic''' was a title bestowed upon [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] by members of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after his heroics during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
